title: CLTR Cutover shared digest definitions
description: Layer 2 shape-only digest definitions. A well-formed digest string proves nothing about whether it matches any actual record's recomputed bytes (Layer 3, src/pcae/cltr/digest.py) -- see CLTR-CUTOVER-EXECUTABLE-SCHEMAS-001 v1.0 Sec.11.

sha256_hex.description: Bare 64-character lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 digest, matching src/pcae/cltr/digest.py's is_well_formed_digest exactly. No 'sha256:' prefix (CLTR-CUTOVER-EXECUTABLE-SCHEMAS-001 v1.0 Sec.11, CONFIRMED-136C-1). Always present when the owning field is present; conditional presence, if any, is governed by the owning schema, not this definition.

record_digest.description: The digest of the companion record document itself. Shape-checked only; never recomputed at Layer 2.

referenced_record_digest.description: The digest of a record referenced by a record_reference tuple (shared/references.schema.json#/$defs/record_reference). Shape-checked only; whether it actually matches the referenced record is a Layer 4 responsibility.

generation_digest.description: The digest of a lifecycle generation referenced by a generation_reference tuple. Shape-checked only; does not imply the generation exists, is certified, or is authoritative.

manifest_digest.description: The SHA-256 digest of a schema resource file's own raw bytes, as recorded in the shared-core schema manifest. Distinct from record_digest: this digests a schema *definition* file, never a record instance.

pointer_digest.description: The digest carried by an authority-pointer-shaped reference. Shape-checked only; this package defines no authority pointer record and does not resolve or create one.

journal_entry_digest.description: The digest of a prior recovery-journal entry in a hash chain. Shape-checked only; chain-integrity verification is a Layer 4 responsibility, deferred beyond this phase.
